title: What If…?
description: FANDUBTaking inspiration from the comic books of the same name, each episode explores a pivotal moment from the Marvel Cinematic Universe and turns it on its head, leading the audience into uncharted territory.

episodes.title: S1-E1What If… Captain Carter Were The First Avenger?
S1-E2What If… T'Challa Became a Star-Lord?
S1-E3What If… The World Lost Its Mightiest Heroes?
S1-E4What If… Doctor Strange Lost His Heart Instead of His Hands?
S1-E6What If… Killmonger Rescued Tony Stark?
S1-E7What If… Thor Were an Only Child?
S1-E9What If… The Watcher Broke His Oath?
S2-E1What If... Nebula Joined the Nova Corps?
S2-E2What If... Peter Quill Attacked Earth's Mightiest Heroes?
S2-E3What If... Happy Hogan Saved Christmas?
S2-E4What If... Iron Man Crashed Into the Grandmaster?
S2-E5What If... Captain Carter Fought the Hydra Stomper?
S2-E6What If... Kahhori Reshaped the World?
S2-E7What If... Hela Found the Ten Rings?
S2-E8What If... The Avengers Assembled in 1602?

episodes_data.title: What If…? 1x1
episodes_data.description: When Steve Rogers is seriously injured, Peggy Carter becomes the world’s first Super Soldier.

episodes_data.title: What If…? 1x2
episodes_data.description: The rough-and-tumble space pirates known as the Ravagers abduct T’Challa instead of Peter Quill.

episodes_data.title: What If…? 1x3
episodes_data.description: Nick Fury struggles to launch The Avengers when candidates are targeted by a serial killer.

episodes_data.title: What If…? 1x4
episodes_data.description: A grief-stricken Doctor Strange uses the Eye of Agamotto in a dangerous effort to change the past.

episodes_data.title: What If…? 1x5
episodes_data.description: When The Avengers are infected by a zombie plague, surviving heroes search for a cure.

episodes_data.title: What If…? 1x6
episodes_data.description: An American soldier called Killmonger rescues Tony Stark when his Humvee is attacked in Afghanistan.

episodes_data.title: What If…? 1x7
episodes_data.description: Thor, who never learned to be a good hero, throws an out-of-control intergalactic party on Earth.

episodes_data.title: What If…? 1x8
episodes_data.description: Natasha Romanoff and Clint Barton seek to destroy killer-robot Ultron following a cataclysmic event.

episodes_data.title: What If…? 1x9
episodes_data.description: The Watcher breaks his oath and recruits heroes from across the multiverse to battle against Ultron.

episodes_data.title: What If…? 2x1
episodes_data.description: When Nebula is recruited to join the Nova Corps, she sets out to prove her detective skills.

episodes_data.title: What If…? 2x2
episodes_data.description: When Ego and a young Peter Quill threaten Earth in 1988, Howard Stark and Peggy Carter form a team.

episodes_data.title: What If…? 2x3
episodes_data.description: When Avengers Tower is attacked during the holiday party, Happy Hogan must prove his hero chops.

episodes_data.title: What If…? 2x4
episodes_data.description: Tony Stark challenges The Grandmaster, leading to a grand prix-turned-demolition-derby death match.

episodes_data.title: What If…? 2x5
episodes_data.description: Captain Carter's mission to save Steve Rogers sets her on a collision course with new enemies.

episodes_data.title: What If…? 2x6
episodes_data.description: A Mohawk woman ventures into the waters of the Forbidden Lake to help save her people.

episodes_data.title: What If…? 2x7
episodes_data.description: Hela—stripped of her powers and banished to Earth—comes across a new source of power: the Ten Rings.

episodes_data.title: What If…? 2x8
episodes_data.description: Captain Carter tries to undo the anomaly that strands familiar heroes and villains in the year 1602.

episodes_data.title: What If…? 2x9
episodes_data.description: Captain Carter discovers the greatest threat to all existence may be closer than she realizes.
